pages.title: Hospital
pages.text: Crash in Skitchin' while your pads are worn out, and you end up in the hospital, out of the race and paying the bill yourself. Hospital is the music for that moment.

pages.title: The paramedics
pages.text: The game's paramedics aren't much comfort. One has heard of road pizza, "but this looks more like road pasta!" Another goes through your pockets for a credit card to cover the damages.

pages.title: Skitchin' after 1994
pages.text: From 1995 to 1997, the Sega Channel offered Skitchin' over cable TV. In 1997 it was one of the top five Genesis rentals at Blockbuster, and in 2017 GamesRadar named it the 49th best Mega Drive game.
